name: List Marketing Emails
description: Retrieves a list of marketing emails. [See the documentation](https://developers.hubspot.com/docs/reference/api/marketing/emails/marketing-emails#get-%2Fmarketing%2Fv3%2Femails%2F)

configurable_props.name: createdAt
configurable_props.label: Created At
configurable_props.description: Only return Marketing Emails created at exactly the specified time. Format: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ

configurable_props.name: createdAfter
configurable_props.label: Created After
configurable_props.description: Only return Marketing Emails created after the specified time. Format: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ

configurable_props.name: createdBefore
configurable_props.label: Created Before
configurable_props.description: Only return Marketing Emails created before the specified time. Format: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ

configurable_props.name: updatedAt
configurable_props.label: Updated At
configurable_props.description: Only return Marketing Emails updated at exactly the specified time. Format: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ

configurable_props.name: updatedAfter
configurable_props.label: Updated After
configurable_props.description: Only return Marketing Emails updated after the specified time. Format: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ

configurable_props.name: updatedBefore
configurable_props.label: Updated Before
configurable_props.description: Only return Marketing Emails updated before the specified time. Format: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ

configurable_props.name: archived
configurable_props.label: Archived
configurable_props.description: Specifies whether to return deleted Marketing Emails

configurable_props.name: sort
configurable_props.label: Sort
configurable_props.description: Sort the results by the specified field

configurable_props.name: maxResults
configurable_props.label: Max Results
configurable_props.description: The maximum number of results to return
